metadata.title: Foxconn India unit reportedly faces insolvency petition over unpaid dormitory rent

content.text:
A local landlord has taken Foxconn's Indian unit to insolvency court over unpaid rent for worker housing at its Bengaluru iPhone plant, adding a supplier-payment dispute to the operational strains the iPhone assembler has faced as it scales up manufacturing...
